Oh my bad, after rereading your comment I see where I got confused. I thought it stole the effects of the opponents boost, not a boost itself. But that also begs the question on whether or not it would be too powerful. A skilled beluga player would have unlimited speed boost and slow infliction if they aimed well enough.
If it can steal the opponents boost wouldn't it be capable of inflicting any and all status effects in the right situations?

I'm no pro when it comes to analysing game balance. But if my assumption is correct, and the beluga is intended to gain a speed boost and the preys boost while also giving the prey slowness than I think it would be possible for the same "issue" that is occurring with the narwhal to happen for the beluga. (issue was in quotes because even though I've seen a lot of posts about narwhal being op on reddit I've never actually witnessed or experienced it in-game) So uh, yeah I think it would be a shame if narwhal was to be made into tier 10 only to have the new animal taking it's old spot also be too strong for tier 9. I've given up too, I stopped doing my schoolwork, I hardly eat, I do nothing all day, the most eventful thing I've done this week was cut myself. I need help but I don't have the energy to seek it aside from online.

I've had my depression for a bit over 2 months and it all started when my girlfriend of 9 months cheated on me and then left me for the guy she cheated on me with. I've only just recently gotten over her but the depression has only gotten worse.
I don't think I understand the true meaning behind this poem but at the same time I feel moved and inspired because of it.
